This topic is part of the AQA GCSE Design Technology specification.

Specialist Technical Principles appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Specialist Technical Principles in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The AQA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Specialist Technical Principles.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
